tools.name: create_hiring_lead
tools.description: Submit a hiring inquiry to Ruzora. Use when a company wants to hire senior LATAM engineers for their team.

tools.name: request_demo
tools.description: Request a demo call with Ruzora. A team member will reach out within 24 hours to discuss your hiring needs.

tools.name: submit_candidate_application
tools.description: Apply to Ruzora's talent network. For software engineers in LATAM interested in remote positions with US startups paying USD salaries.

tools.name: create_factory_inquiry
tools.description: Request a custom software project from Ruzora's Software Factory. Fixed-price development by senior LATAM engineers.

tools.name: list_open_roles
tools.description: Get all currently open engineering roles at Ruzora. Returns titles, tech stacks, experience levels, and application URLs.

tools.name: get_job_details
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific job role including responsibilities, requirements, and tech stack.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Get comprehensive information about Ruzora's services, process, value proposition, and differentiators.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_open_roles · Public sink: create_hiring_lead, submit_candidate_application.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_open_roles · Public sink: create_hiring_lead, submit_candidate_application

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
